name: Alabama Metal Fabricators Inc
old_description: Since 1995, Alabama Metal Fabricators, Inc. has been serving the needs of companies throughout the southeast. Companies rely on the quality and innovative work from Alabama Metal Fabricators, Inc.
about:
Alabama Metal Fabricators, Inc. was founded in 1995 and operates from its headquarters at 27094 Highway 98 in Elberta, Alabama, a small city in Baldwin County near the Gulf Coast. The company began as an industrial mechanical and general contractor serving businesses across the southeastern United States.

Its service portfolio includes industrial mechanical contracting, general contracting, plant-wide maintenance programs, field construction, and custom metal fabrication. The company does not publish facility square footage, employee count, or production volumes, but describes its team as experienced professionals dedicated to timely, quality work.

The firm markets itself to companies throughout the Southeast, without specifying particular industry sectors or customer names. Its website navigation highlights fabrication, field construction, equipment, and work in progress as primary activity areas.

A stated point of distinction is the company's safety record. Alabama Metal Fabricators maintains a safety program driven by education and employee awareness, and has been recognized with the Zenith Safety Award in 2001, 2006, and 2007, as well as the Alabama AGC Safety Award in 2003, 2006, and 2007.
built_on: Proven safety program based on education and employee awareness
type_evidence: We are an industrial mechanical/general contractor and can provide plant wide maintenance service in addition to field construction services.
